name: Involved user function
description: For each active user task of the current process instance (optionally filtered by task id), list the involved users: the assignee, the candidate users, and the members of the candidate groups.

properties.label: Filter Task Ids
properties.description: TaskElementId or List<TaskElementId>. Only compute involved users for these task ids (user task element id). Leave empty to process every active user task of the process instance.

properties.label: Fail when user or group are not found
properties.description: If true, the function fails when a candidate/assignee user, or a group, can't be found. If false, the user is skipped.

properties.label: Max users reported
properties.description: Maximum number of involved users reported per task.

properties.label: Add users
properties.description: Add user in the involved list on each task. Input is a String of UserName, separate by comma, or a List of UserName (String)

properties.label: list of involved users
properties.description: list of User, all task included

properties.label: Detail task involved users
properties.description: Map, keyed by task id, of the task information (taskName, dueDate, documentation) and the list of involved users (assignee, candidate users, members of candidate groups)

properties.label: ControllerPage Expression
properties.description: Expression to define BPMN Errors to throw
properties.value: if is defined(error) then bpmnError(error.code, error.message) else null
